groups.label: Main blooms
groups.blurb: Purple and pink hydrangeas with soft roses and tall spires — the vintage violet palette of this butterfly piece.

items.role: Purple hydrangea heads anchoring the upper part of the arrangement.
Pink hydrangeas softening the violet tones.
Light pink Austin roses with full, rounded petals.
Champagne Austin roses adding a warm vintage tone.
Pink ranunculus with delicate layered petals.
Purple delphinium spires lifting the arrangement.
Yellow delphinium sprays adding bright golden accents.

groups.label: Small accents
groups.blurb: Fine purple and daisy accents scattered through the display.

items.role: Purple forget-me-not clusters adding fine violet texture.
Yellow daisies echoing the golden delphinium tones.
White daisies scattered as light, airy dots.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: Soft green texture and fine trailing lines grounding the piece.

items.role: Deep green asparagus fern providing a lush base.
Fine asparagus fern branches adding airy greenery.
Trailing fine grass softening the edges like fountain grass.
Creamy statice spray filling gaps with a soft haze.
Fine-leaf eucalyptus threading green through the palette.
